title: Three states from one selector redirect: a 247-state ZFC consistency machine
prepared_for: Vladimir Reshetnikov and the ProveIt project
artifact_kind: Research construction with a conventional mathematical proof and executable certificates

claim.statement: ZFC proves: the exact 247-working-state binary machine does not halt from its blank initial configuration iff Con(ZFC).
claim.proof_method: Universal word and finite-list induction, all guarded symbolic instruction cases, complete-frame simulation, exact blank startup, safe-root enumerator completeness, and the specifically identified set-coded native/ZF/ZFC interpretation.

machine.halting_semantics: Perform the final write and move into the separate halt label; halted execution is absorbing.

intermediate248.description: Delete states 1 and 3 and replace state 0/read-zero by (1,L,2); identify state 0 with 20. The intermediate-to-final quotient is exact on every tape. The modification of Prefix250 is justified on valid recurrent frames, and the final blank startup is checked separately.

proveit.identity_check_scope: Source identity only; not a kernel rebuild and not rerun by the offline verifier.

preserved_prefix250_audit.historical_results_scope: The preserved reports and results in reference250 concern the earlier 250-state machine.

earlier_prefix250_working_report.role: Earlier carry, rollback, spare suffix and pulse initializer construction; dependencies needed for reproduction are retained in reference250.

public_historical_overview.role: Prior-art orientation; exact machine and proof identities are taken from pinned repositories.

proof_scope.complete_frame: Old state 96 at h, one marker at h-1, a clean PC of length at most d, d >= 40, nine physical primary blocks, a nonempty finite spare suffix, and entirely blank exteriors.
proof_scope.unbounded_register_contracts: All nonnegative primary values, every nonnegative extra header gap, and every finite nonempty spare suffix. The zero-decrement branch always has a following block.
proof_scope.spare_invariant: Increment appends value 1; other instructions preserve the nonempty suffix.
proof_scope.simple_safe_root_specialization: EnumSafeStart254.zero_formula_start_iff 0 3 3, through L2.iter_iff, RMEquiv254.path_halts_iff_iter, and Bisim254.prog254_halts_iff.
proof_scope.nonzero_counter_completeness: EnumSafeStart254.complete_from and pad_code_ge pad a refutation to a candidate code at least the current counter.
proof_scope.zfc_internal_reading: Finite syntax, finite traces, natural and list induction; set-coded Henkin completeness; native-model bisimulation quotient and internally well-founded definable subdomain; internal constructible subdomain of a set model.
proof_scope.positive_time_reflection: Each returning macro segment takes at least 13 literal steps; reverse halting reflection is induction on binary halting time.

verification.independent_review_path_convention: The independent review preserves original research-workspace paths and hashes. Packaged Python files have portability and strict dependency checks added; the final delivered versions are exercised by code/verify.py.

reproduction.python_requirements: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only, assertions enabled.
reproduction.pdf_requirements: pdfLaTeX, latexmk, and the packages listed in report.tex.
